question_or_proposition: For Pentachlorophenol at Outfall 001, does the PART I Section A effluent limits and monitoring table row—with N/A in all numeric limit columns, 'Report' in the final concentration-limit column, measurement frequency '1/Quarter', and sample type 'Grab'—establish quarterly grab-sample monitoring and reporting without any enforceable numeric discharge limitation?
required_context: PART I Section A table column headers distinguishing loading limits, concentration limits, measurement frequency, and sample type
The Pentachlorophenol row and structurally parallel pollutant rows (e.g., Cadmium, Aldrin) that share the N/A/Report/1/Quarter/Grab pattern
notes: Resolving this proposition determines whether Pentachlorophenol is classified as report-only with no numeric compliance comparison (Purpose A), whether quarterly grab monitoring was an applicable requirement (Purpose B), and how missing or non-numeric Pentachlorophenol results are categorized under missing-evidence semantics (Purpose C).
